fran: Quick postmortem follow-up for the routing hiccup. Need owners for status page, customer email, public RCA and a short redaction checklist. Please claim by EOD.

omar: Can we include an RCA ETA on the status page? Customers want dates.

fran: Proposed ETAs: status page in 2h, customer email in 8h, public RCA in 5 business days. Open to changes.

selina: Draft status blurb:

``
Incident: Router error (partial)
Impact: ~8% of requests saw elevated errors between 09:10-09:38 UTC
Mitigation: Traffic reroute restored service levels by 09:30 UTC
RCA ETA: 5 business days
``

omar: +1 to ETA line. I'll take the status page update (@omar) ETA 2h.

selina: I'll draft the public RCA (technical) and include recent recurrence notes. Assigning to @selina ETA 5bd.

fran: I'll draft the customer email (targeted, non-technical). Assigning to @fran ETA 8h.

selina: Redaction checklist for any external comms: 1) remove request_ids and tokens; 2) anonymize IPs/hostnames; 3) aggregate counts only; 4) round timestamps to minute blocks; 5) send final draft to legal if any customer strings present.

legal: Use the legal scan and tag @legal. We aim for 48h turnaround on complex redactions.

status-bot: Incident digest posted to status.redwood.ai  update queued by @omar.

fran: I'll post a tracker doc with owners and ETAs and link it here. Please update if timelines slip. React with :thumbsup: when you accept. Closing assignment thread for now. :white_check_mark:
